quote.summary: RelyEZ Energy Storage Technology Co., Ltd. is a China-based company principally engaged in the provision of energy storage system (ESS) solutions, hardware products, software systems or platforms, and supporting services. The Company mainly operates three businesses. The large-scale and commercial and industrial (C&I) ESS solutions business is mainly engaged in offering integrated ESS solutions, including large-scale ESS solutions and C&I ESS solutions. The sales of ESS products business is mainly engaged in selling ESS hardware or software products. The operation and maintenance (O&M) and entrusted power trading services business is mainly engaged in providing overall operation and maintenance services of energy storage power stations, including routine and ad hoc inspections, maintenance of power station facilities, deployment of qualified personnel and daily station management. The Company mainly operates its businesses in domestic and overseas markets.
